findings.highlight: It’s already been an hour since we got here
findings.evidenceJa: ここに網を張ること一時間
findings.governingReading: We have lain in wait here with our net spread for an hour
findings.explanation: The planned ambush image and purpose of the hour disappear.

findings.governingReading: There is still time to stop this
findings.explanation: Shirou’s last chance to interrupt Rin is rendered as an unexplained personal deadline.
